coverage.assessment: Two revision cuts damage logical links. Dropping the captious critic leaves 'than for themselves' unanchored. Dropping 'Thus far it had remained in the eighteenth century' leaves 'Education went backward' without its mechanism. The Gymnasium motive and the cabman payoff are also thinned.
Locations and movements are clear. Sumner becomes 'his friend' without the 'young worshipper' setup, a minor referent gap that the next chapter's 'oldest friend' partly covers.
Sumner's boast is kept as performed speech with its 'or Rome' aside. Apthorp's protest and Adams's 'loathed Beethoven' reply are correctly attributed, and the turn order is intact.

Key qualifiers survive ('when any one was looking at him', 'or seemed to make, notes', twelve or thirteen). The Gymnasium critique has lost its mitigations ('neither very brutal nor very immoral'), which makes the indictment harsher than the source.
The Marx line stays retrospective ('he had no idea'). The London and Antwerp fifty-year returns remain flashes forward, and the Wagner note is kept as a plant without expansion.
The aphorisms and semicolon catalogues survive. The revision cut two signature images: the Antwerp Cross close and the Beethoven 'new language'/flower passage. The Heine refrain is also reduced.
The accidental-versus-planned education contrast holds. The historical-regression frame (18th then 16th century) and Adams's distrust of the new sense are weakened.

The Pandects, Beethoven, dynamo and Wagner plants all survive locally and have live partner endpoints. Chapter 029 cut its exact quoted line, but it still names the 'Gotterdammerung' and sets Wagner in New York.

strengths: Paragraph 1's catalogue of mock-virtues keeps every ironic qualifier ('when any one was looking at him', 'towards a superior', 'if he had any'), exactly as the risk note asked.
The Marx sentence remains clearly retrospective, and the London fifty-year chiasmus ('grew smaller as it doubled in size') is intact.
The Civil Law argument (useless without Common Law; read the Pandects and be his own professor) survives whole after 'His first lecture was his last.'
The Apthorp/Gymnasium facts are precise: Apthorp's ten-year-olds versus the Ober-tertia of twelve or thirteen, for three months.
The closing cadence from the father's letters to the Thuringen tramp and 'it should not be again in Berlin' is preserved in full.
summary: The revision keeps all seven verbatim anchors and every continuity check. The retrospective Marx line, Apthorp proposing the Gymnasium, boys of twelve or thirteen, the smile/tear farewell and both fifty-year flash-forwards are intact, and all four planned dependencies still connect. There are no blockers. The revision's own cuts do some damage: the captious-critic irony, the explicit eighteenth-to-sixteenth-century 'backward' step, the Antwerp Cross cadence, and much of the Beethoven awakening's texture are gone. First-draft cuts had already removed the poodle/cabman payoff and the school's mitigating qualifications. Small restorations would recover most of this.
